title: Tensions Between the Proxies of Human Values in AI
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally a position paper on the ethics of AI, specifically critiquing how human values like fairness, privacy, and transparency are mathematically formalized. It includes a deep discussion on the nature of ethics (e.g., stating 'Ethics are fuzzy' and determining 'what is ethical' is disputable), moral values, and ethical responsibility beyond simple technical metrics.
